meta.prompt: Create an inline music card for ‘Dreams’ by Fleetwood Mac, with sand-toned sunset art. Start paused at 3:02 of a 4:17 track. Show progress and time labels with previous, play/pause, and next. Tapping the main control should play the same track and show no missing values.
meta.text:
The error came from putting the state and timer lines above the root. A single root must come first, with everything else indented under it. Here the state and timer are declared inside a Column root, so the layout has one root and the timer runs only while playing.

Column w:390 pad:16
  state playing=false
  state elapsed=182
  every 1s when playing -> elapsed=min(257,elapsed+1)
  NowPlaying =playing title:"Dreams" artist:"Fleetwood Mac" kind:"dusk" tone:"sand" elapsed:=elapsed length:257 -> skip=result
